data.long_meaning: In Persian culture, Farrokh is derived from the old Persian word 'Farroxša' which means 'Bringer of Good Fortune'. It is a name that symbolizes prosperity, happiness, and good luck. The name Farrokh carries the meaning “Bringer of Good Fortune” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farrokh usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of good fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
